page.notes: The paragraph ending "guberna-" is cut off at the foot of the page; the continuation "bernaculis" is on the next page. The Greek-looking "a" in "guberna-" is likely a printer's Cyrillic-like shape; I transcribed it as a Latin "a" with uncertainty. The left margin note "z 2.Sam.13" is partly blurred; the "z" may be a mark and is copied as seen. The running head "LIB. I." is read as part of the head line. The page number is printed at upper left. The reference mark "*" beside "Ammon" is left as printed in the text with no matching note. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
